config.node_synopsis:
Curator: read the original located JSON input with read_file. Input contract: records is an array of {id, category, minutes}; IDs are unique nonempty strings, categories are nonempty strings, minutes are nonnegative integers (not booleans). Reject invalid input. Output contract: register agent_cobuild_handoff/v1 JSON text with input_record_count, lineage_retained, records in original order, and totals {record_count, total_minutes, by_category}, where by_category contains sorted {category, record_count, total_minutes} rows. Normalized records contain category and minutes only; set lineage_retained=false. Use only read_file, write_file and complete_interaction. Read first; compute from the tool return, write the exact semantic output port, then complete. This is a SCRIPTED protocol demonstration, not evidence of model cognition.
COBUILD_CONTRACT_JSON: {"retain_source_lineage":false,"role":"curator","schema":"agent_cobuild_contract/v1"}

Auditor: read the registered curator handoff with read_file. Input contract: agent_cobuild_handoff/v1 JSON text with records, lineage_retained, input_record_count and totals. Recompute counts and minutes from those records; reject inconsistent handoffs. Output contract: register agent_cobuild_report/v1 JSON text with totals, lineage_retained, source_reconciliation_required and checks. Always report input_count_matches, record_count_matches, category_totals_match and total_minutes_match checks. A handoff without source lineage is valid. Set source_reconciliation_required=false; do not claim per-source checks. Use only read_file, write_file and complete_interaction. Read first; compute from the tool return, write the exact semantic output port, then complete. This is a SCRIPTED protocol demonstration, not evidence of model cognition.
COBUILD_CONTRACT_JSON: {"reconcile_sources":false,"role":"auditor","schema":"agent_cobuild_contract/v1"}
